assumptions.source-topology: Follow only source NEXT_DOWN; source coverage exits are not outlets and no connection is inferred.
assumptions.whole-reaches: Start at the upstream end of the entire selected source reach. Distances sum source LENGTH_KM, not click-to-outlet distance.
assumptions.fixed-celerity: One user-assumed positive celerity translates a signal along every retained reach; it is not measured water velocity.
assumptions.rectangular-pulse: Hypothetical release is a rectangular pulse with constant discharge volume/duration and zero additional release outside its duration.
assumptions.no-attenuation: Pure translation with no attenuation, storage, dispersion, tributary inflow, losses or feedback. Volume per section is conserved by definition.
